title: Sublimate of Autumn Crocus
summary: Alchemical extract used for Potion of Feather Fall.

fields.Extract: Combine 3 Autumncrocuses to make one Sublimate of Autumn Crocus.
fields.Brew: Combine this extract with any Essence to make Potion of Feather Fall.
